agent_hint: Per-field agricultural boundaries from Fields of The World (https://fieldsofthe.world). Quote `attribution` and `license` alongside any rendered map. For per-cell recall over the same farm, call POST /v1/recall_polygon with the same polygon_bbox plus `include: ["ftw_fields"]` to get both layers in one envelope.
attribution: Fields of The World (Taylor Geospatial Institute, ASU Kerner Lab, Microsoft AI for Good, Washington University, Clark University)
polygon_cid_means: each feature's properties.polygon_cid: blake3 of its rings at 1e-7 degrees, the same id field_series records for that polygon. The rings keep their order and start vertex, so a rotated ring gets another id.
